description: This source file defines the internal utility classes 'ReferenceEqualsComparer' and 'ReferenceEqualsComparer<T>' for reference-based equality comparison within the Orleans framework. It includes singleton instances and methods for equality checks and hash code generation based on object reference.

classes.name: ReferenceEqualsComparer
classes.description: A singleton class implementing IEqualityComparer<object> that uses reference equality.

classes.name: ReferenceEqualsComparer<T>
classes.description: A generic singleton class implementing IEqualityComparer<T> where T is a class, using reference equality.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if two objects are equal based on reference equality.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on object reference, or 0 if null.
